title: fix(lint)!: a _relatedLists translation key over a list the .custom arrangement hides or re-states without a label is refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPE7uyDAJyqjwwMzomWv5ff)_

Fixes #36595

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37620

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：只影响作者跑 `os validate`。如果应用的定制包（`.custom`）把某个相关列表标签页隐藏了，或者改成不带标题的写法，而翻译包里还留着这个标签页标题的译文，现在会报错，提示这条译文没人读。以前这种译文校验能通过，但页面上本来就不会显示它。
- 为什么做：这是 #36595 剩下的第 4 项。校验规则先看到「原对象给这个列表写了标题」就放行了，没有考虑定制包会把整条替换掉，结果作者以为翻好了，实际页面看不到。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是把一条其实有用的译文误报成错。规则的判断和运行时 registry 应用定制编排的顺序、覆盖规则逐条对齐，有测试钉住；第一方示例和 HotCRM 里没有命中的写法。
- 要你做什么：这是收窄（以前能过的现在报错），属 Tier H，需要审批人批准；还欠契约审核（L2）。

## What changes

**The reading** (at `origin/main`): the registry applies the paired `.custom` arrangement after the owner's tab list and every `place` entry, and each arrangement entry REPLACES every entry it covers (`packages/objectql/src/registry-custom-arrangement.ts`, the `relatedLists` step; `relatedListNameCovers`: the same list, or a bare child for every list of that child). `{ list, hidden: true }` leaves no tab; a bare name or an entry with no `label` leaves the tab titled by the child FK's `relatedListTitle`. The lint fold (`validate-translation-references.ts`) checked the owner's labelled set first and `continue`d before the hidden check, and `object-graph.ts` dropped the arrangement's bare names (`.filter(isRec)`). So `_relatedLists.<list>` over an owner-labelled list the arrangement hides or names bare was accepted though nothing reads it.

- **`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`**: `VisibleObjectExtension` gains `relatedListArrangement`, the extension's `relatedLists` as written, bare names included (`undefined` when it writes none). `relatedListEntries` is unchanged.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`**: per target, placements are folded first (the arrangement's own entries skipped), then every extension's arrangement in fold order, each in two passes as the registry reads it: first its entries drop every label (and earlier `hidden`) they cover, then it adds its own labelled entries and its hidden ones. So one entry never strips the label a sibling of the same arrangement gives (`[{ list: 'event.related_to', label }, 'event']` resolves in either order). The hidden message now matches by cover, so `{ list: 'event', hidden: true }` names `event.related_to` as hidden. A key over an owner-labelled list the arrangement re-states without a label names the arrangement, and its hint (like the hidden one) points at the owner's `label`.
- **ADR-0087**: semantic entry `translation-related-list-key-under-arrangement-refused` at step 19 (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.…`; `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is 19.0.0, so `migrate meta --from 18` lists it), and the changeset is marked `registered`. No D2 conversion: dropping the key or re-stating the arrangement's entry with the owner's own label is the author's call. The remedy names the owner's label because an object read translates a label only while it still equals the packaged one; its surface names the labelled bare child `{ list: 'event', label }` covering the owner's `event.related_to`.
- **Docs**: the `_relatedLists` row of the reference-rule table in `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` states the arrangement's effect.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/lint` minor with the BREAKING note, `@objectstack/spec` patch (the ledger entry).

Small calls made here (no card), per seat route 7120211674 (option A, item 4 only):
- The lint fold applies every extension's `relatedLists` as an arrangement, as it already did for `hidden`. The registry serves only the object's own pair and names the other writers, which is a separate refusal at publish / `os validate`. This fold does not re-derive which package is the pair.
- `os i18n extract` (`i18n-walk.ts`) still scaffolds `_relatedLists.<list>` from the owner's labelled entries and reads no extension, as before this change. In a stack that holds both the owner and its `.custom` pair, it can scaffold a key this rule now refuses. That universe difference predates this PR (the extractor reads no extension at all). It is filed with the object-read pair-catalog gap as #37622, not widened in this PR.

## Why

The card's item 4 (from the contract review of #36574): a permissive lint that let a translator ship a title the record page never shows. Items 1–3 landed in #36813.

## Verification

- `packages/lint/src/i18n-related-lists-arrangement-36595.test.ts` (new, 7 tests):
  - An owner-labelled list the arrangement hides is refused with the hidden message.
  - The same list named bare, as `{ list }` or as `{ list, hidden: false }`, is refused with the no-label message, which names the `.custom` arrangement.
  - A bare child beside its labelled dotted list in one arrangement leaves the label, in either order (fails on `61beb993c`). A sibling cancelling a `hidden` entry has no pin: a list both shown and hidden in one arrangement is refused at save by the object schema (`refuseContradictoryRelatedListEntries`).
  - A bare child hides or strips the dotted owner entry.
  - The arrangement is applied after a placement that another package folds later, at higher priority.
  - A relabelled list and lists the arrangement does not cover resolve.
  - Control: with no arrangement, nothing changes.
  - Red first: against `origin/main`'s two source files, 4 of the 6 fail; with the change, 6/6 pass.
- `i18n-related-lists-label-36528.test.ts` (the existing `_relatedLists` pins, the `hidden: true` one included): unchanged and passing.
- Local runs, head `b18f2ca55` (contract-review fixes; `61beb993c` before):
  - `@objectstack/lint` full vitest: 237 files, 9,687 passed.
  - `tsc --noEmit` and eslint on the touched files: exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/spec` vitest `src/migrations`: 201/201.
  - `check:generated --fix`: all up to date. `gen:migration-registry` picks up the entry. `check:upgrade-guide`: ok.
  - `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: ✓ registered. `check-empty-changeset`: ✓. `overlap-check`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery: on `61beb993c`, os-dev report 7196396955 (one load timeout in an unrelated install-local case, green when rerun alone). On the final head `b18f2ca55`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 488/491 (3 skipped), Tests 4135/4203 (68 skipped), no failure; os-dev report 7197867160.

Contract review (L2) is owed before landing: the diff declares `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and adds a `packages/spec/src/**` ledger entry. Tier H: an authorized approval is needed to land.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
